component.name: AstraPlay
component.summary: Free and Open Source Remote Play Client

description.p: AstraPlay is a free, community-built, open source remote play client forked from Chiaki. It focuses on maintaining internet remote play across platforms and aims to keep the app easy to access through major app marketplaces. Supports PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 consoles.

screenshot.caption: Browse your game catalog for internet play streaming
Auto-discover and connect to your PlayStation console

description.p: Hardened in-app auto-updater with SHA-256 checksum verification against release digests.
AES-256 encrypted credential vault for desktop secrets and tokens bound to hardware identity.
Embedded PSN login relay TCP stream framing, rate-limiting, and memory bounds protection.
Enforced strict TLS certificate and hostname verification across remote holepunch transport.
Added hardware controller profile for ASUS ROG Xbox Ally X (PID 0x1b4c).
Simplified PS sign-in with clear 3-step workflow and direct authentication links.
Smart auto-extraction for 64-character account codes from clipboard or webpage.
Enhanced Android TV and Fire TV D-pad remote navigation.
In-app PSN relay configuration and offline account connection options.
Performance, UI responsiveness, and streaming stability improvements.

Cloud Play fixes for regions without native PlayStation cloud support: the streamable PS3 and PS4 catalog is restored, and titles such as Bloodborne now launch correctly. Improved store routing and reliability for all regions.
Fix Steam shortcut creation for games on Flatpak and refresh shortcut branding.
Improved controller support and various bug fixes.
Improved cloud game language support and region fallback.
Major update: improved PS5 cloud game catalog, ownership, and locale handling on desktop.
Steam Deck: add Gaming Mode shortcut on first launch and Flatpak Steam library access.
Fixes for cloud game discovery, QR login layout, and settings across platforms.
Rebrand user-facing names from chiaki-ng to AstraPlay across macOS, desktop, and packaging.
Version bump; release branches aligned with master.
Initial AstraPlay release on Flathub.
